ROTARIAN LAL GOEL PRESENTS TWO-YEAR ROADMAP TO POSITION KARNATAKA AS A NATIONAL LEADER IN ORGAN DONATION AND TRANSPLANTATION
progress review meeting of the Executive Committee of the State Organ and Tissue Transplant Organisation (SOTTO), Karnataka, held on 22 October 2026 at Arogya Soudha, Bengaluru.
Shri U. T. Khader, Hon’ble Minister for Health and Family Welfare, Government of Karnataka, convened the meeting to review the state’s progress in organ donation, with particular emphasis on deceased organ donation and the measures needed to strengthen the transplantation ecosystem.
Karnataka Records Its Best-Ever Performance in Deceased Organ Donation
